title: Elena sì... ma di Troia
writer: Mario Amendola, Alfonso Brescia, Renzo Genta
actors: Don Backy, Piero Scheggi, Howard Ross
plot: Ottone and Savio, vagabonds coming from Etruria, find themselves on the shores of Ancient Greece in search of bread and adventures. They are welcomed by Paride and Elena and taken to the palace of Menelaus.
